scope: Every audio track under music/, including game masters and source variants; dialogue and SFX excluded

tracks.transcript: The world changed double when Fancy FM fell, arpeggios climbing, tension rising, one beer donos us, and everything returns, no human vocal sounds. The motif resolves on a long held note, the tape slows down, and stops no human vocal sounds.

Fragments of the five-note motif on a muted bell, far away, a reversed sound now and then, a ticking hi-hat, no human vocal sounds. The pulse tightens, a filtered analog sequence creeps in, tension that never resolves, loop-friendly, no human vocal sounds.
Three-year dark synthwave groove, tight hunchulin drum kick and gated snare, driving analog octave bass, hot desert wind and metallic scrap percussion. Intense and cinematic, never rave music.
